process_failure_prevention.incident: Menschen A1 C49 report-only UNREVIEWED loop
process_failure_prevention.rule: Routine safe semantic edits are authorized for agent decision; do not request repetitive user approval. Apply decisions directly to newest mutable CURRENT in the same work turn, run post-edit QA, persist recoverably, and only then count APPLIED. Independent adversarial QA is a separate acceptance gate, not permission to defer writing.
process_failure_prevention.exception: Ambiguous source fidelity, destructive change, missing exact CURRENT, concurrent writer, LOCKED content, architecture/UI change require guard/hold.
process_failure_prevention.acceptance: A regression test must fail when a reviewed correction exists only in a report or patch while CURRENT remains unchanged; and pass when CURRENT diff, post-edit test, and durable readback agree.
